title: Switchboard After-Hours Telephone Log & Action Report
brief: An after-hours security guard call log and handover report drafted from dispatch phone records for the overnight shift at a commercial business park.

slip.document:
# Switchboard After-Hours Telephone Log & Action Report
Facility: Crestview Technology Park - Building 4 Console
Shift: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00)
Date: 03/24/2026
Duty Officer: Officer Darren Vance (Badge #412)

## Master Facility Directory
| Unit / Tenant | Contact Person | After-Hours Protocol | Authorized Phone |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Suite 100 - Apex Logistics | Marcus Vance | Call primary mobile; dispatch supervisor | 555-0143 |
| Suite 210 - BioWave Labs | Dr. Elena Rostova | Immediate dispatch for cold-storage alarms | 555-0188 |
| Suite 305 - ClearPath Data | Nathan Reed | Urgent tickets via web portal only | 555-0192 |
| Facility Management | Rachel Ortiz | Facilities emergency only (leaks, power) | 555-0115 |

## Incoming Call Records
- 22:42 - Caller: Marcus Vance (Apex Logistics). Inquired if Bay 3 overhead door was secured. Officer checked CCTV monitor 2, confirmed Bay 3 roll-up door is closed and locked. No dispatch required.
- 01:15 - Caller: Alarm Central Monitoring. Automated notification of freezer unit temperature spike in BioWave Labs (Suite 210). Officer contacted Dr. Elena Rostova at 555-0188. Keyholder acknowledged and estimated arrival on-site at 02:00.
- 02:40 - Caller: Unknown vendor requesting delivery dock access for morning freight. Advised delivery window begins at 06:30 per park rules.
- 03:55 - Caller: Cleaners for ClearPath Data. Janitorial lead reported low water pressure on 3rd floor restrooms. Advised this is non-emergency; logged for day maintenance.

## Shift Summary & Action Items
- Alarm Central Monitoring incident resolved; Dr. Rostova arrived at 02:05 and cleared the lab alarm at 02:22.
- Marcus Vance called regarding Apex Logistics Suite 210 bay doors, which were verified secure.
- Relieving officer must review all open maintenance items upon morning handover at 06:00.
